title: UPT quantity registry
description: The shape of data/quantities.json. src/dimensional/quantity-registry.ts validates the file against this schema when it loads, with the keyword subset src/core/json-schema.ts reads. A constant's spellings are not written here: the constant registry names its quantity and the quantity registry derives those aliases.

id.description: The canonical id, or a spelling row (graphNode false). `_` and `-` are one character to every lookup, so two rows may not differ only there; the loader checks it.

attributes.description: Axis → value. The axes and their values are the attribute registry's; this file only states strings.

kind.description: The QuantityKind of a temperature-like quantity.

signRole.description: The SignRole of a signed quantity.

dimension.description: SI base exponents, all seven stated.
